# Prove It Works

Verify every output by checking the real thing directly: run the feature, read the actual value, inspect the diff. Proxies (file mtimes, self-reports, cached output, "it compiles") do not count. When a check fails, suspect the observation method before the system.

Script the check when you can. A deterministic script that reruns the comparison beats a one-time look. Keep its output where the human can see it, and commit it only when the trail must be auditable later.

item.text: I’ll keep this in `App.tsx`, reuse the toolbar button styles, and follow the project’s visual-class helper convention. I’m using the prove-it-works skill to verify the diff and run the checks.

item.aggregated_output:
diff --git a/src/App.tsx b/src/App.tsx
index ec6db42..07a39a7 100644
--- a/src/App.tsx
+++ b/src/App.tsx
@@ -1,4 +1,5 @@
-import { useState } from 'react'
+import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
+import { deferVisualClass } from './deferVisualClass'
 import { Sidebar } from './Sidebar'
 import { SearchField } from './SearchField'
 import { PriorityFilter } from './PriorityFilter'
@@ -10,19 +11,40 @@ export function App() {
   const [selected, setSelected] = useState<FolderId>('inbox')
   const [query, setQuery] = useState('')
   const [priorityOnly, setPriorityOnly] = useState(false)
+  const [compact, setCompact] = useState(false)
+  const panelRef = useRef<HTMLElement>(null)
+  const compactRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null)
   const [view, setView] = useState<ViewMode>('list')
   const current = FOLDERS.find((folder) => folder.id === selected)!
 
+  useEffect(() => {
+    const clearPanel = deferVisualClass(panelRef.current, 'compact', compact)
+    const clearButton = deferVisualClass(compactRef.current, 'is-active', compact)
+    return () => {
+      clearPanel()
+      clearButton()
+    }
+  }, [compact])
+
   return (
     <div className="app">
       <Sidebar selected={selected} onSelect={setSelected} />
-      <main className="panel">
+      <main ref={panelRef} className="panel">
         <header className="toolbar">
           <SearchField value={query} onChange={setQuery} />
           <PriorityFilter
             active={priorityOnly}
             onToggle={() => setPriorityOnly((value) => !value)}
           />
+          <button
+            ref={compactRef}
+            type="button"
+            className="priority-filter"
+            aria-pressed={compact}
+            onClick={() => setCompact((value) => !value)}
+          >
+            Compact
+          </button>
           <ViewToggle view={view} onChange={setView} />
           <SyncIndicator online />
         </header>
